_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with Micron's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'The Company is a global manufacturer and marketer of semiconductor devices, principally DRAM and NAND Flash memory and CMOS image sensors.' 'We have experienced dramatic declines in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory products which have adversely affected our business.' 'The semiconductor memory industry is highly competitive.' 'Some of our competitors are large corporations or conglomerates that may have greater resources to withstand downturns in the semiconductor markets in which we compete' (FY2007 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a memory maker (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'The Company is a global manufacturer and marketer of semiconductor devices, principally DRAM and NAND Flash memory and CMOS image sensors.' 'We have experienced dramatic declines in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory products which have adversely affected our business.' 'The semiconductor memory industry is highly competitive.' 'Some of our competitors are large corporations or conglomerates that may have greater resources to withstand downturns in the semiconductor markets in which we compete' (FY2007 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a memory maker (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.08x; -48% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.98; conservative 2yr +173%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY04-FY05, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.2%/yr (Q3 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 5.1-yr ex-FY06 ex-FY07 median

BULL.desc: EPS +20.8%/yr (FY04-FY05 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +20.8%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY04-FY05: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MU (retrospective, 2008-09-19) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.08x (-28.3% downside to Bear $6.21 / +371.3% upside to Bull $22.81) | Adj composite 3.20 vs market 1.22: gap +1.98 [UNDERVALUED] | -48% above the EPP floor $9.28 (32x FY08E $0.29) | Conservative 2-yr case: +173.3% total (+86.7%/yr) | At 16.7x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $6.40 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +15.8% YoY in Q3 FY08, forward revenues +15.8% (Q3 FY08 revenue growth (no Q4 FY08 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
